name: Happy happy - Parl
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR(MAIDA), SUGAR, REFINED PALM OIL, CHOCO CHIPS(8.4%), [SUGAR, EDIBLE VEGETABLE FAT (HYDROGENATED OILS), COCOA SOLIDS, DEXTROSE, EMULSIFIER (SOY LECITHIN) AND ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (VANILLA)], INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, COCOA SOLIDS (0.5%), IODISED SALT, RAISING AGENTS [503 (ii), 500 (ii)] AND EMULSIFIER OF VEGETABLE ORIGIN (472e) CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL FOOD COLOURS [ 150c, 150d ] AND ADDED FLAVOUR (ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES - CHOCOLATE).
